info.name: Hercules DJControl Mix Ultra
info.author: openDJ
info.description: Hercules DJControl Mix Ultra, written for openDJ from the controller's user manual and the MIDI notes djay Pro's built-in mapping uses. Works over USB or Bluetooth MIDI.

control.description: BROWSER: turn to move through the list
SHIFT + BROWSER: turn to scroll a page
BROWSER press: open the folder or load the track
NEURAL MIX: the EQ knobs set the stems' volumes
SHIFT + CUE: play from the start, deck 1
LOW (stem volume with NEURAL MIX), deck 1
MID (stem volume with NEURAL MIX), deck 1
HIGH (stem volume with NEURAL MIX), deck 1
FX pad 5: next effect in slot 1, deck 1
FX pad 6: next effect in slot 2, deck 1
FX pad 7: next effect in slot 3, deck 1
FX pad 4: effect unit on this deck, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 1: play stem 1 alone, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 5: mute stem 1, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 2: play stem 2 alone, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 6: mute stem 2, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 3: play stem 3 alone, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 7: mute stem 3, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 4: play stem 4 alone, deck 1
NEURAL MIX pad 8: mute stem 4, deck 1
SHIFT + CUE: play from the start, deck 2
LOW (stem volume with NEURAL MIX), deck 2
MID (stem volume with NEURAL MIX), deck 2
HIGH (stem volume with NEURAL MIX), deck 2
FX pad 5: next effect in slot 1, deck 2
FX pad 6: next effect in slot 2, deck 2
FX pad 7: next effect in slot 3, deck 2
FX pad 4: effect unit on this deck, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 1: play stem 1 alone, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 5: mute stem 1, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 2: play stem 2 alone, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 6: mute stem 2, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 3: play stem 3 alone, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 7: mute stem 3, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 4: play stem 4 alone, deck 2
NEURAL MIX pad 8: mute stem 4, deck 2
